description: TPU v3-inspired pair; synthetic 50 GB/s link and latency, fixed compute times.
assumptions: Two endpoints with one FullyConnected dimension, not the TPU pod 2D torus.
50 GB/s link bandwidth, 500 ns link latency, and 10-cycle endpoint delay are synthetic assumptions, not TPU ICI measurements.
900 GB/s memory bandwidth and 123 TFLOPS BF16 are reference values only; roofline is disabled.
Network settings intentionally match two_rank: equal fixed-duration workloads should have equal timing.
